name: Paget Disease of Bone
definition: Focal disorder of accelerated and disorganized bone remodeling that can enlarge and weaken affected bones.

investigations.principle: ALP and characteristic imaging guide diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: MRI is used for neurological or malignant complications.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs show cortical thickening, expansion and mixed lytic-sclerotic change.

amber: New focal severe pain or mass requires evaluation for fracture or rare malignant transformation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikara phenotype may be documented descriptively only.

patientEducation.summary: Focal disorder of accelerated and disorganized bone remodeling that can enlarge and weaken affected bones.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
